scope: all repository public HTML and course JSON
approval_claim: NOT_ASSESSED — this audit does not claim or predict Google AdSense approval

content_depth.note: Threshold is a triage signal, not a word-count publication rule. The count that matters for publication is thin_indexable: a noindex utility page (404, a JS shell that redirects) is short on purpose and is not judged for depth. CJK and Thai text is counted per character — those scripts have no spaces, and counting them by whitespace made a complete Japanese page look thin.

duplicate_risk.note: Every group is a paragraph an editor should look at, not proof of duplication. The two pages in the introductions group are the same tutor rendered twice — a home-page card and a roster row share her subject list because it is her list. Shared data is not doorway content; a page whose whole body repeats another page is.

policy_pages.note: Cookie/consent applicability and behavior require jurisdictional/legal review; file presence alone is not compliance.

indexability.js_only_value: REVIEW_REQUIRED — rendered learning value requires browser/manual sampling

mobile.note: Static source scan cannot validate viewport overlap, responsiveness, accidental taps, or device performance.

accessibility.note: Automated source signals only; keyboard, screen reader, contrast, captions, and zoom require rendered audit.

ad_safety.note: Placement, consent, content/ad balance, mobile accidental-click risk, and approval status require rendered and policy review.

consent.note: A certified CMP and geographic messages must be verified in Google Privacy & messaging; repository code cannot establish account-side activation.

account_formats.note: Auto ads format eligibility, activation, exclusions, ad load and Offerwall settings require account review.
